content.rendered: Our Spring book fair is May 8th through the 16th. The book fair will be open to parents and families on the elementary conference days, May 8th, 8:00am-8:00pm, and May 9th, 8:00am-12:00pm. The remainder of the days, students will shop during their class library time. Check out our Media Center home page HERE for more information.
